description: This file contains interface and class definitions for subscriber grains that participate in broadcast channel streaming within Orleans. It defines interfaces for different types of subscriber grains, a base class implementing common functionality for managing received values and errors, and two concrete grain classes with specific channel subscription attributes.

classes.name: SubscriberGrainBase
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing shared functionality for broadcast channel subscriber grains, including error and value tracking, subscription handling, and error simulation.

classes.name: SimpleSubscriberGrain
classes.description: Concrete implementation of a subscriber grain with implicit channel subscription.

classes.name: RegexNamespaceSubscriberGrain
classes.description: Concrete implementation of a subscriber grain with regex-based channel subscription.

methods.name: GetErrors
methods.description: Retrieves list of errors associated with the specified stream ID.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves list of values associated with the specified stream ID.

methods.name: GetOnPublishedCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of how many times the OnPublished event was triggered.

methods.name: ThrowsOnReceive
methods.description: Sets whether the grain should throw an exception upon receiving a message.
